```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "General Entity">
  <!ENTITY % pent "Parameter Entity">
  %pent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY img SYSTEM "test.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising comment parsing paths -->
  <ns2:child>
    <?ns2-pi data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like strings: <root>&ent;</root>
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA | sub)*>
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % extDTD SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  %extDTD;
  <!ENTITY ref "Expanded &subref;">
  <!ENTITY subref "Nested Value">
]>
<?processing-instruction target="test" data="data=\"foo\""?>
<doc xmlns="urn:doc:base" xmlns:x="urn:doc:x">
  <!-- Comment inside document root -->
  <x:sub>
    <![CDATA[Another CDATA section with entity reference candidate &ref;]]>
  </x:sub>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % markup "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %markup;
  <?target-pi data-attr="test"?>
  <!ENTITY custom-entity "Entity Content">
]>
<catalog xmlns:foo="http://foo.org" xmlns="http://bar.org">
  <!-- Multiple comments
       across lines -->
  <foo:item>
    <![CDATA[
      <foo:item>Nested CDATA</foo:item>
    ]]>
    &custom-entity;
  </foo:item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY b1 "XML Parsing Guide">
  <!ENTITY b2 "Advanced Fuzzing">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY pEnt 'Parameter Content'>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org" xmlns:bk="http://books.org">
  <!-- Inventory main container -->
  <bk:book>
    <bk:title>&b1;</bk:title>
    <bk:author>
      <![CDATA[Author Name with <brackets> & ampersands]]>
    </bk:author>
  </bk:book>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, heading, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY cdata-proxy "Proxy text">
  <!ENTITY % nested-param "<!ENTITY deep 'Deep entity'>">
  %nested-param;
]>
<?target data?>
<note xmlns="http://w3.org/note" xmlns:pref="http://w3.org/pref">
  <!-- Reminder comment -->
  <pref:to>Tove</pref:to>
  <pref:from>Jani</pref:from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Don't forget the meeting! &deep;
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```
